groups.activity: Exterminate, wake the Angel, then sweep the map

rows.label: Voidplume Pinion
rows.note: build requirement; one per dormant Angel

conditions: Rank 0 → 1 costs 5,000 standing plus 5 Voidplume Down; Rank 1 → 2 costs 22,000 standing plus 10 Voidplume Vane and 10 Voidgel Orb. The blueprint then costs 6,000 standing.
The daily cap is 16,000 + 500 per Mastery Rank. At MR 14 it is 23,000, so the standing portion takes at least two days from zero.
A dormant Void Angel drops a Pinion. Void Armageddon's Ravenous Angel drops a Quill instead, so do not use Armageddon for Pinions.
Squad Voidplume pickups are shared. Finish the objective, then use loot radar and container-breaking coverage to find plumes; Parallax Orokin Eye marks plumes and Accolades.
bonuses: Each map has one Crest, two Vanes, and five Down-or-Vane pickups. Yonta's Voidplume stock refreshes every eight hours and can fill missing rank-up sacrifices.
Follow Lost Spirits after the Exterminate objective: they lead to a nearby Voidplume, Ayatan, or Somachord.

disclosures.title: Pinions set the practical pace
disclosures.body: The rank gate is short compared with the 15 Pinions. Plan on about 15 Zariman missions with a dormant Angel; this is a long evening or two of focused runs, assuming no host migration losses.

conditions: Trading the blueprint bypasses the Rank 2 purchase, but it does not avoid the 15 Pinions and other Zariman build materials.
You may craft Phenmor before Mastery Rank 14, but cannot equip it until then.

groups.meta: apply a perk before the next tier tracks

rows.label: Void Angel primary-fire headshots without reloading
Solo mission with Incarnon weapons in every slot

conditions: Evolution II only counts Incarnon-form kills: charge the gauge with weakpoint hits, use alt-fire to transmute, then kill Eximus units.
Evolution III uses base-form primary fire. Stack magazine size and multishot, reduce damage so the Angel survives, and use Mag's Magnetize or another crowd-control ability to keep shots on its head.
The Evolution III streak resets on reload and does not persist between missions. Client progress can fail to register, so run solo if a challenge stalls.
Evolution V requires an Incarnon primary, secondary, and melee in one solo mission; Exalted weapons do not qualify.
bonuses: For the common Devouring Attrition build, avoid raising critical chance: its +2000% damage proc triggers on non-critical hits.

disclosures.title: Evolution III is the real wall
disclosures.body: The Angel headshot challenge is much harder than acquiring the rifle without a purpose-built setup. A high magazine, multishot, low-damage base-form build plus Magnetize makes all 20 headshots practical in one Angel fight.
